findings.title: 负滞环值被额外判为错误，题面未要求
findings.requirement_basis: 题面只定义两个错误条件：loLevel>=hiLevel 得16#8001；hystWindow >= (hiLevel-loLevel) 得16#8002。负 hystWindow 未定义
findings.code_evidence: IF (hystWindow < 0.0) OR (hystWindow >= (hiLevel - loLevel)) THEN error := TRUE; status := 16#8002;
findings.trigger_sequence: hystWindow = -1.0, hiLevel = 100.0, loLevel = 0.0（loLevel<hiLevel 且 -1.0 < 100.0，不满足任何题面错误条件）
findings.expected: 按题面两个错误条件均不成立，不应置 error=true/16#8002（负值未定义，可保留告警逻辑正常运行）

protocol: Fresh context with question and candidate only; no author dialogue or existing test outcomes; static hypotheses, not confirmed defects
